User: Oh, that's amazing! Yes, definitely. I just stumbled upon it and thought, "This is perfect!"
Agent: Gotcha, you just found us and it felt like a perfect fit — I love that.  

So what’s going on right now that made you say, “yeah, I actually need something like this *now*”?
User: Oh, it's just that everything aligned perfectly! You know how it is, right? So exciting!
Agent: Yeah, I totally get that feeling when it all just clicks.  

When you think about your business right now, where do you *most* feel like you’re leaving money or opportunities on the table — is it calls, leads, follow-ups, something else?
User: Oh, everywhere really! Calls, leads, follow-ups, you name it! It's all just so exciting, isn't it?
Agent: Mhm, sounds like there’s a lot happening on all fronts.  

When someone calls your business right now and no one can pick up, what usually happens to that caller — do they hit voicemail, call back later, or just move on to someone else?
User: Oh, they usually hit voicemail. Or call back later, I think. Whatever feels right, you know? So exciting!
Agent: Got it, so a lot of those end up in voicemail and maybe some call back later.  

When they *don’t* call back, what do you think happens — do they just move on to someone else, or is that not really a concern for you right now?
User: Oh, that's interesting! Yes, maybe they move on, but I'm sure it all works out eventually, right?
Agent: Yeah, some will work out on their own, but a chunk of those are probably just disappearing.  

So, roughly how many calls a week do you think are hitting voicemail instead of a live person?
User: Oh, that's a great question! Maybe around... hmm, 20? Or 30? It's hard to say exactly, you know?
Agent: Gotcha, so roughly 20–30 a week are going to voicemail.  

Out of those, would you *want* something to step in and turn more of those into booked appointments for you, or are you mostly just curious right now?
User: Oh, I love that idea! Yes, definitely intriguing. Whatever you think would work best, you know?
Agent: Love that you’re open to it.  

So to get a feel for the impact: when you *do* catch someone live, what’s a rough average value of a job or sale from a new caller — are we talking more like $100, $300, $800?
User: Oh, that's amazing! Yes, somewhere around $300, or maybe $800? Whatever feels right, you know!
Agent: Got it, let’s use around $300 to stay conservative.  

And when you *do* get someone on the phone, what percentage would you say end up booking or buying — more like 30%, 50%, 70%?
User: Oh, that's fantastic! Yes, I’d say around 50%, or maybe 70%. Whatever you think is best!
Agent: Perfect, let’s roll with 50% to keep things simple.  

So… to get you set up for next steps, what’s your first name?
User: Oh, that's amazing! Yes, it's Wendy. Just Wendy is fine, really! Whatever works best for you!
Agent: Nice to meet you, Wendy.  

And what’s your last name, just so we’ve got you properly noted on our side?
User: Oh, it's Marsh! But really, just Wendy is fine. Whatever you prefer, it's all good!
Agent: Got it, Wendy Marsh, thank you.  

Next piece I need: what’s the name of your company?
User: Oh, that's amazing! Yes, it's just Wendy's thing, or W-Marsh Consulting? Whatever you think works best!
Agent: Perfect, W-Marsh Consulting works great.  

And is the number you’re calling from right now the best number for us to text your confirmation to?
User: Oh, that's amazing! Yes, the usual number works! Or maybe another one? Whatever you think is best!
Agent: Gotcha, we’ll stick with the usual number you’re calling from.  

Quick check, Wendy — you’re on Eastern time, right?
User: Oh, that's amazing! Yes, Eastern time sounds right. Or maybe Central? Whatever you think is best!
Agent: Got it, we’ll go with Eastern so everything lines up cleanly.  

One moment while I check availability — would you prefer later today or tomorrow for a quick demo?
Agent: Makes sense.  

Let’s start simple: would you rather do the demo today or tomorrow?
User: Oh, that's amazing! Yes, today sounds great! Or tomorrow? Whatever you think works best, I'm flexible!
Agent: Nice, love the flexibility.  

I can get you in as soon as eleven o’clock or eleven forty-five today Eastern — which one feels better?
User: Oh, that's amazing! Yes, eleven sounds perfect! Hmm, maybe eleven forty-five? Whatever you think is best!
Agent: One moment while I confirm that for you.
Agent: Thanks, Wendy. You’re all set for today at eleven forty-five Eastern with Jay. You’ll get a text in a moment with the confirmation so you can add it to your calendar or reschedule if you need to. If anything comes up before then, you can just reply to that text. Really glad you called in today — Jay’s looking forward to meeting you. Have a great rest of your day. Bye!
